Sunty Bhai :-
After exploring Canada, we were finally heading back to the United States, crossing from Saskatchewan into Montana through a small and remote border crossing.
What I expected to be a simple immigration process turned into one of the most exhausting border experiences of my travels!
The US immigration officers questioned me extensively about my travels, my background, and the purpose of my visit. The questioning went on for hours, and they even checked my phone!
We ended up spending almost 3 HOURS at immigration, answering questions and going through the inspection process.
